Class StripeService.StripeTransactionProcessExecutor

private class StripeService.StripeTransactionProcessExecutor
implements Finalizer

Finalizer class that manages the sequential execution of Stripe transaction processing jobs. Orchestrates the chaining of multiple queueable jobs (StripeTransactionProcessor, LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments, AssignReferences, and GetStripeBalanceTransactions) based on completion status. Handles error logging and ensures proper job progression through the processing pipeline.

Methods

public void execute(FinalizerContext context)

Executes finalizer logic to chain the next job in the processing pipeline. Based on the caller class name, determines which job to enqueue next. Handles error logging if the parent job failed and manages cursor positioning for job continuity. Skips execution during test runs.

Parameters:
    context – FinalizerContext: The finalizer execution context
